Changed

  • Maintenance window: the cross-off checkbox is now a 🗑 trash button with a confirm. The checkbox looked like Hahns was recommending the item. Now each item has a trash button — click it and confirm (*“Are you sure you want to remove …?” Yes / No*) to take that line off the list (e.g. a cabin filter or sunroof clean done last visit) before printing. Yes removes it; No puts it back.
